gloss: free; not busy (お手すきの時に)

definitions.gloss: free; not busy; having a moment
definitions.explanation: Having one's hands free: not occupied with work for the moment. Mostly met in the polite お{手|て}すき, used to ask someone to do something when they have time, especially in business emails and calls. Also written {手隙|てすき} or {手透|てす}き.

examples.japanese: お{手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Please do so whenever you have a moment.

examples.japanese: {手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Anyone who's free, please help out at reception.

examples.japanese: お{手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{添付|てんぷ}→添付：07376_tenpu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です。
examples.english: I would be grateful if you could look over the attached materials when you have a moment.

notes:
お{手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is a soft way to make a request without implying urgency; it suits messages to colleagues and clients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / {時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: when you have a moment
- {手|て}すき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: whoever is free (on a team)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}が{空|あ}く→手が空く：30590_tegaaku⟧: to become free; the verb phrase
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧: free time; plainer, and rude in a request (お⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧な{時|とき} can sound like "since you have nothing to do")

WATCH OUT:
{手漉|てす}き (handmade, of paper) has the same reading but is a different word.
